name_en: Kogyo no tempura — tempura of Lake Biwa's small native fish
summary_ja: 小あゆやイサザ、ワカサギなど琵琶湖でとれる小魚を素揚げにする天ぷら。魚ごとに漁期が異なるため、組み合わせればほぼ通年味わえるとされ、揚げたては川魚特有の匂いが気にならないという。
summary_en: Small fish native to Lake Biwa — koayu, isaza goby, or smelt — are battered and deep-fried. Because each fish has a different season, some combination is available almost year-round, and freshly fried, the fish loses the aroma freshwater fish are sometimes known for.
source_title: 湖魚の天ぷら 滋賀県
